family: The single total language defined by the evaluator in proof.md. At actual length N<2^20 output zero. Otherwise choose b as the least positive integer with b^5>=N^3 and ell as the first prime strictly larger than b. Put r=floor(N/ell)-1 and t=ceil(sqrt(r)). Read the first ell bits as the coefficients below the leading term of a monic degree-ell binary polynomial P. Output zero unless X^(2^ell)=X modulo P and gcd(P,X^2-X)=1. For a valid prefix, read the next r*ell bits as x_1,...,x_r in F_2[X]/(P), in the polynomial basis with constant coefficient first. Set y_i=x_i^(2^(r+2-i)-1) and output the absolute trace of the order-t elementary symmetric polynomial in y_1,...,y_r. Ignore the final N-(r+1)*ell bits. Every prefix and ignored bit counts in N. One fixed polynomial-time evaluator and empty-witness NP verifier define all lengths.
theorem: For this one fixed total language in P, hence in NP with witness bound zero, every exact circuit in the full pinned B2 model at actual length N has at least 4*N-14*N^(4/5) gates for every integer N>=2^20, and at least 4*N-13*N^(4/5) gates for every integer N>=2^25. Consequently liminf over all integer lengths N of C_B2(F_N)/N is at least 4. The same evaluator and verifier apply throughout both bounds and all asymptotic quantifiers.
